data.body: Organic post-merge observation and residual-hypothesis disposition: run 31846417650 on merged instrumentation dynamically measured socket.getfqdn=35.013s, ThreadingHTTPServer constructor=35.014s, surrounding _server fixture=35.020s, and no >1s TCP bind span. No other individual default-tier operation/test exceeded 30s. The same macOS job completed 81s after its last runner step, but this is not attributable to the 300 timing warnings: seven comparison macOS jobs without this instrumentation had 50-76s last-step-to-job-complete gaps, and run 31848073556 had 70s with only the pre-existing 24 warnings. Warning fanout is therefore rejected as a distinct material finalization cause; the control-plane tail is a stable ~1m platform overhead. Change 1795 owns the proven DNS mechanism repair and preserves the timing observer by retargeting its constructor wrapper to the new production subclass after valid LLM review feedback.
